headline: AppLovin shares tumble as revenue miss and cautious outlook outweigh earnings beat
summary: AppLovin Corporation (NASDAQ:APP) shares plunged more than 14% in premarket trading on Thursday after the software company delivered quarterly earnings that exceeded expectations but failed to satisfy investors on revenue growth and forward guidance. For the second quarter ended 30 June, AppLovin reported adjusted earnings per share of $3.
